extras.quota_verbatim: Unlimited storage; 1 user. Free 5 GB tier exists.
extras.limits_verbatim: Constraint type: per-ip-shaping, upload side only. Reported throttle at 6 TB is ~1.85 MB/s per transfer; at 44 TB one Duplicati user measured 250 KB/s. Download path unaffected. Non-commercial licensing on the Personal tier.
extras.egress_verbatim: No egress fee and no download throttle. Vendor text: 'Reduced upload speed means that uploading files from your device to Jottacloud might take a little longer. Download speed and other use of the service is not changed, and you can still store as much data as you need in your account.' Upload is throttled once >5 TB stored: 'If you store more than 5 TB of data on Jottacloud, your upload speed is automatically reduced. The reduction in upload speed is greater the more data you store in your account.'
extras.chaining_verbatim: rclone -> local -> any S3/WebDAV target; can front with Cloudflare only by proxying your own origin, not directly
extras.tooling_verbatim: rclone native backend, supports --fast-list; CLI documented
extras.interface_verbatim: Web + desktop + rclone (native `jottacloud` backend, documented on rclone.org)
extras.price_verbatim: $2.76/TB at 5 TB; $0.69/TB at 20 TB (NOK 129/mo = $13.79 flat, so marginal cost per added TB is $0)
